integrity: An ordinary analytic proof with independent regenerative-reward and time-integration checks; finite numerical tests support but do not replace proof. No independent scientific validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact model assumes strictly positive iid identical orientation durations, no thermal diffusion and harmonic confinement. Finite-data inverse stability and general infinite-second-moment weak-trap behavior are unproved. Publication-priority residual risk for broader linear-filter renewal results.
title: Sharp dwell-time noise bounds and trap-spectroscopic recovery for alternating-renewal propulsion
